10.text: BOW AND ARROWS. — For shooting, the bow was used until recently,

11.text: and in some remote places it is still used by a few people. In former times

12.text: it was the favorite weapon of the Chukchee; and as late as the thirties in

13.text: the nineteenth century, the official reports of the Anui fair, speaking of the

14.text: number of Chukchee comers, say that there were so and so many camps,

15.text: with so and so many Chukchee men “versed in archery.”

16.text: The epic tales are full of descriptions of shooting-bouts and contests.
